name: Elanaria
summary: Elanaria is a night elf warrior mentor and coordinator stationed on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She directs developing fighters across Kalimdor, testing their mettle against dangerous threats such as the satyr Vorlus Vilehoof and spiritual entities like the Shade of Elura. Her guidance serves as a crucial bridge for Alliance soldiers honing their martial prowess in the night elven capital.

sections.title: A Sentinel of the Terrace
sections.body: Standing proudly on the Warrior's Terrace within the boughs of Darnassus, Elanaria serves as an instructor and point of contact for martial champions. In an era where the night elves have formally aligned with the Grand Alliance, her role extends beyond mentoring local Sentinels to preparing warriors of all backgrounds for the harsh challenges facing their lands.

sections.title: Trials of Iron and Spirit
sections.body: Elanaria does not offer easy praise; she expects discipline, resilience, and proven strength. She assigns seasoned adventurers to strike down formidable adversaries plaguing Ashenvale and Darkshore, including the corrupt satyr Vorlus Vilehoof and troubled spirits like the Shade of Elura. She also liaises with skilled craftsmen like Smith Mathiel to ensure that deserving warriors are properly armed for war.

faq.answer: Elanaria is a night elf located on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She serves as a martial quest giver who tasks rising warriors with combat trials throughout northern Kalimdor.
She is located on the Warrior's Terrace, the elevated northern district of Darnassus dedicated to the city's military training grounds and defenses.

Elanaria is a key figure in intermediate warrior progression, offering assignments such as hunting down the satyr Vorlus Vilehoof, confronting the Shade of Elura, and coordinating with local armorers like Smith Mathiel.

faq.q: Why does Elanaria send fighters against Vorlus Vilehoof?
faq.answer: Vorlus Vilehoof is a dangerous satyr whose demonic corruption threatens the northern wilds. Elanaria tasks capable warriors with slaying him to both safeguard the forests and prove their battlefield prowess.
Smith Mathiel is a master armorer stationed in Darnassus. Elanaria directs warriors to Mathiel so they may craft or receive specialized martial equipment suitable for frontline combat.

faq.q: Does Elanaria interact with non-night elves?
faq.answer: Yes. As part of the Alliance, Elanaria assists all eligible Alliance warriors who arrive on the Warrior's Terrace seeking guidance and specialized training.

angles.text: Elanaria is an essential contact on the Warrior's Terrace, assigning level-appropriate martial trials that reward sturdy equipment and refine tactical combat skills.
Representing the martial traditions of Darnassus, Elanaria works to purge corrupted entities like satyrs and restless shades from the ancestral lands of the kaldorei.
From the capital of Teldrassil, Elanaria helps maintain military readiness and arms soldiers who defend Alliance interests across northern Kalimdor.
